column1: # Library code for tools/fwsrc.py: these parts of the image are linked from the stock
# toolchain's own objects (GNU Arm Embedded 5-2016-q1-update, multilib armv7e-m/fpu, see
# tools/fetch_toolchain.py) instead of being generated from the image.
#   file NAME[@VMA] INPUT...   the files.tsv file NAME is these input sections, in this order;
#                              @VMA: they run at VMA in RAM, NAME holds their load image
#   at ADDR INPUT...           these sections sit at ADDR in RAM, without bytes in the image
#   symbol NAME FILE|ADDR      a linker symbol: the start of a files.tsv file, or an address
#   source OBJECT PKG/PATH     OBJECT is compiled from the ST library file PATH (PKG: a package
#                              tools/fetch_toolchain.py installs) with the stock compiler and
#   cflag FLAG                 a compiler flag for every source; -IPKG/PATH names a directory
#   export OBJECT SYMBOL [NAME]  make OBJECT's static SYMBOL global, renamed to NAME:
#                              generated code calls it by its stock name
# INPUT is OBJECT(SECTION ...): crtbegin.o, crti.o, crtn.o, ARCHIVE:MEMBER or a source
# OBJECT. Every other section of a listed object is discarded, as the stock link's
# --gc-sections did; the build fails if a kept section needs one.
file crti                    crtbegin.o(.eh_frame) crti.o(.init) crtn.o(.init) crti.o(.fini) crtn.o(.fini)

# differ from V2.2.1 (USB_OTG_EPDeactivate is older code) stay generated.
